meta.note: Minerals reported at the targets in cited papers, and the mineral families used to compare them with NASA EMIT identifications at Earth sites (data/sites.json, mineralogy). Site-level result only, added after the freeze of 2026-11-14: never part of the all-round score. An EMIT identification is a spectral match in a 60 m pixel, not an abundance; a rover result is a laboratory measurement of one sample. A shared family is a pointer, not proof.
meta.emitMinimumShareNote: An EMIT family counts when it is matched in at least 1% of the clear pixels of the footprint. A display rule.
meta.emitSource: NASA EMIT L2B Estimated Mineral Identification and Band Depth (EMITL2BMIN), LP DAAC; method: Brodrick et al. 2023, EMIT L2b ATBD, JPL D-104479

access.FT: full text of the paper was read
